title: 第十章 朋友第一更第十一章 怪物宝贝
content_zh:
，，！
一夜无梦，睡得酣然。
清晨，网球休息室，王长乐眼睛盯着窗外的学校。
只见两辆相互追逐的重卡，在学校里横冲直撞，巨大的轰鸣声吸引着众多丧尸的围攻，也有更多的丧尸丧命于重卡的车轮之下。
“啪”
一声枪响之后，是持续按动的重卡车笛，响亮的鸣笛声在整个校园内回荡，也吸引了更多的丧尸蜂拥而至。
“轰~boo~乓”
一辆重卡车，突然从超市前面的围墙直接撞了出去。
下一秒，就出现在网球馆不远处的街道上，最后直接撞进了一家门店内，鸣笛声依旧。
无数汹涌的丧尸从缺口内冲出，而后面的那重卡也顺势从那个缺口冲了出来，一路将沿路的丧尸碾压冲撞。
趁着这个间隙，他已然开着辆小型货车，呼啸着从校园后方出口摸了进去。
一脚油门停在了出口处，下了车就往校园操场的方向跑。
瞥了眼在千米外不断挖取丧尸结晶的二女，他没有选择靠近。
而是选择远远的跟在后面，把一具具被取走结晶的丧尸收进空间。
是的，他的目的就是这些尸体。
这些面目可怖，浑身尸臭，额头还开了一个大洞的丧尸！
在别人眼里可能是无用的废物，可是在他眼中却是一笔意外的财富。
这些虽只是最低级的1级丧尸，而且还被挖走了魔力结晶，但好歹也是变异的丧尸，尸体上面多少都会有些能量残留。
这种能量对别人可能没用，但是对院落里的血色蔷薇却是有用。
只要收集足够的丧尸，就能换取更多的血肉蔷薇了，那可是可以带出末日轮盘世界的道具。

倏尔发现，利用印记空间收取丧尸，既方便又快捷。
手掌划过就收取成功，一次装载5具尸体，再跑回小货车即可。
不多时他就收获了200具丧尸的尸体，通过植物反馈发现叶钟鸣正在快速接近。
为了不影响剧情发展，他选择战术撤退。
现在的他，还没有能力承受改变剧情之后的变数。
而且这次的主线任务对他来说至关重要，所以平稳的剧情发展对他才更为有利。
这样他才能吃到剧情信息差的福利，就像现在这样，很快就来到了老式院落门前。
一夜的时间，院落里的蔷薇却有了很大的变化，不仅每朵花的体型似乎都有所增大，白洁的花朵中，还掺杂着些许粉色。
本来只局限于院落的蔷薇花，现在已经长到了街道上了。
层层叠叠的花朵似乎还在一点点的向着四周蔓延，渐渐的占据了小半个街道。
微风吹过，花朵如同海浪一般起伏摇动，美丽梦幻，当王长乐如同以往释放精神波动，想要与其交流。
万千蔷薇花中却有一个男性丧尸出现，其脑后连接着一根长长的藤蔓，牵引的来到王长乐身前。
看着眼前这超现实的一幕，王长乐都有些惊了，它似乎进化了。
“你好，我的朋友。
这次，你又给我带来了什么惊喜？”
不带一点感情的声音，从面前的丧尸口中传出，这不是自然之心的反馈，而是真实的声音。
仅仅一个晚上的时间，它就已经从精神交流进化到了言语交流，虽然是通过控制其他丧尸实现，不过这也太超前了。
“你能说话了？你又进化了？”
“是的，谢谢你昨天带来的礼物。
content_en:
,,!
A dreamless night, a sound sleep.
In the early morning, in the tennis lounge, Wang Changle stared at the school outside the window.
I saw two heavy trucks chasing each other, running rampant in the school. The huge roar attracted many zombies to attack, and more zombies died under the wheels of the heavy trucks.
"Pa"
A gunshot was followed by a heavy truck horn that continued to sound. The loud horn echoed throughout the campus, attracting more zombies to swarm in.
"Boom~boo~pong"
A heavy truck suddenly crashed through the wall in front of the supermarket.
The next second, he appeared on the street not far from the tennis stadium, and finally crashed directly into a store, the sound of the horn still ringing.
Countless surging zombies rushed out of the gap, and the heavy truck behind also rushed out of the gap, crushing and colliding with the zombies along the way.
Taking advantage of this gap, he drove a minivan and roared in from the rear exit of the campus.
He stepped on the accelerator and stopped at the exit, got out of the car and ran towards the campus playground.
Glancing at the two women who were digging for zombie crystals a thousand meters away, he did not choose to get closer.
Instead, he chose to follow from a distance and collect the zombies whose crystals had been taken away into the space.
Yes, these corpses were his goal.
These zombies have horrible faces, are full of corpse odor, and have a big hole in their foreheads!
In the eyes of others, it may be useless trash, but in his eyes, it is an unexpected wealth.
Although these are only the lowest level 1 zombies, and the magic crystals have been dug away, they are still mutated zombies, and there will be some energy left on the corpses.
This energy may not be useful to others, but it is useful to the bloody rose in the courtyard.
As long as you collect enough zombies, you can exchange for more flesh roses, which are props that can bring you out of the world of Doomsday Roulette.
Su'er discovered that using the imprinted space to collect zombies was both convenient and fast.
Just swipe your palm to collect it successfully, load 5 corpses at a time, and then run back to the pickup truck.
Not long after, he harvested the corpses of 200 zombies, and found through plant feedback that Ye Zhongming was approaching quickly.
In order not to affect the development of the plot, he chose a tactical retreat.
Now, he is not able to withstand the changes after changing the plot.
And this main mission is very important to him, so a smooth plot development is more beneficial to him.
In this way, he can enjoy the benefits of poor plot information. Just like now, he soon arrived in front of the old-fashioned courtyard.
Over the course of one night, the roses in the courtyard changed a lot. Not only did each flower seem to have increased in size, but the white flowers were also mixed with a little pink.
The roses that were originally confined to the courtyard have now grown into the streets.
The layers of flowers seemed to be spreading around little by little, gradually occupying less than half of the street.
The breeze blew, and the flowers undulated and swayed like ocean waves, beautiful and dreamy. When Wang Changle released his spiritual fluctuations as before, he wanted to communicate with him.
Among the thousands of roses, a male zombie appeared, with a long vine connected to the back of his head, pulling him to Wang Changle.
Wang Changle was a little shocked when he saw the surreal scene in front of him. It seemed to have evolved.
"Hello, my friend.
What surprise did you bring me this time? "
An emotionless voice came from the mouth of the zombie in front of him. This was not the feedback from the heart of nature, but a real voice.
In just one night, it has evolved from spiritual communication to verbal communication. Although it is achieved by controlling other zombies, this is too advanced.
"Can you speak? Have you evolved again?"
"Yes, thank you for the gift you brought yesterday.
